response.overview: When a young driver’s car breaks down near a remote village, he is forced to stay temporarily at the home of a woman named Zaya. But his unexpected arrival slowly disturbs the quiet rhythm of her life, drawing her into a world of fear, doubt, and suspicion. As his presence grows increasingly unsettling, Zaya begins to question whether his appearance at her door was merely an accident or part of something far more mysterious.
response.title: Foggy Hilltop
